summary: Phased offboarding for VP transitioning to external consultancy — 30d read-only Git access & conditional KMS handoff
description:
Issue summary:
VP (external-market partnerships) has accepted a short-term consultancy arrangement with a key partner. People Ops requests a phased offboarding plan that preserves read-only access to specific repositories and customer-facing artifacts for 30 calendar days to support a defined handover, and a controlled KMS key handoff to avoid breaking running integrations. This is an exception to standard immediate offboard for execs.

Impact:
- Business continuity: ongoing partner transition depends on VP's ability to respond to repo questions and review docs for 30 days.
- Security: VP currently has admin-level access to several repos and production-facing service accounts.
- Crypto assets: VP is listed as a key admin on KMS key alias projects/cc-infra/* and on a legacy HSM-backed key used by a partner integration.

Background/constraints:
- VP start date: 2018; has access across multiple teams.
- Agreement: consultancy begins 2026-03-20; People Ops requests primary de-escalation (remove write/admin rights) effective 2026-03-17, but retain read-only repo access and email/Slack for 30 days.
- Legal requires a hold on deletion of any artifacts and audit trail for the period.
- Partner integration uses KMS key with two admins: VP and infra-service-account. Full rekey could disrupt partner integration if done before partner-side rotation.

Requested phased plan (proposed):
1) 2026-03-17: Remove admin and write permissions from all GitHub org teams; change primary login MFA device registration to company-managed device. Leave read-only repo access listified to only the repos enumerated below.
2) 2026-03-17: Rotate service account credentials where VP was sole owner; assign ownership to named service account or team rotation policy.
3) 2026-03-18 to 2026-04-16: Maintain read-only repo access and allow Slack/email contact. Enable "retained access" label and escalate any privilege change requests to People Ops + Legal.
4) 2026-04-17: Complete KMS key rekey and remove VP from key policies after partner rotation confirmed; revoke read-only access on 2026-04-17 unless extended in writing.

Repos to retain read-only access (initial list provided by manager):
- partnerships/partner-onboarding
- marketplace/integrations/partner-x
- docs/partner-playbooks

Required approvals: People Ops (Lena Sato), Legal (J. Morales), Security (SRE lead).

Requested actions for assignee (Aiden):
- Inventory all repos, org teams, service accounts, and KMS keys where VP is listed. Provide a short table (CSV paste) of findings by 2026-03-12.
- Implement permission changes on 2026-03-17 at 09:00 PT; coordinate with People Ops and Security.
- Hold on destructive KMS operations until partner confirms rotation and Legal signs off.

Notes on risk:
- If KMS rekey happens before partner rotation, partner integrations may break.
- Leaving read-only access increases audit scope; we must capture privileged sessions and ensure logging retention for 90 days.

Contact for follow-up: Lena Sato (People Ops) and J. Morales (Legal counsel).

Follow-up tasks: export audit logs for 90 days, confirm infra-service-account co-admin on legacy KMS alias, revoke read-only access on 2026-04-17 unless extension requested.
